summary: Branding feature (iter 11): 22/26 backend pytest PASSED. 4 RBAC failures (same root cause: require_roles() implicit-admin bypass). Frontend e2e: public login branding, live color preview, upload/resize/WebP, PNG favicon, delete asset, features editor, save + tab title/favicon live update all WORKING. Regressione plans/login/clienti OK. CRITICAL: RBAC leak — regular admin can reach /admin/branding backend + frontend route + sees 'Branding' + 'Pannello SaaS' in sidebar.

critical.issue: Regular admin (admin@cleantec.it, role='admin') receives 200 instead of 403. Per spec these are superadmin-only. Root cause: core.require_roles() implicitly whitelists role='admin' (already flagged in iter10 code-review). For branding the endpoints must explicitly reject 'admin' — e.g. wrap require_roles('superadmin') with a strict check that `user.role == 'superadmin'` and raise 403 otherwise.

minor.issue: Router sets 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=300' but the preview ingress rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. Not a code bug, infra-side. Documented for awareness.
Empty file returns 422 (FastAPI multipart validation) instead of the intended 400 'File vuoto'. Functional but inconsistent with the docstring.

ui_bugs.issue: `return i.roles.includes(user.role) || user.role === 'admin'` makes every item visible to any user with role='admin', so regular admin sees 'Pannello SaaS' (/admin) and 'Branding' (/admin/branding) in sidebar. Fix: replace with `return i.roles.includes(user.role)` (and keep the superadmin branch already present).

Regular admin navigating directly to /admin/branding lands on the Branding page (ADMIN_CAN_SEE_BRANDING_PAGE=True). ProtectedRoute likely reuses the same implicit-admin allowlist pattern. Must strictly enforce user.role === 'superadmin' for superadmin-only routes.

action_items: Fix require_roles('superadmin') (or wrap in branding.py) so role='admin' returns 403 — affects GET/PUT /admin/branding, POST /admin/branding/upload/{kind}, DELETE /admin/branding/image/{kind}.
Fix Layout.jsx sidebar filter: remove `|| user.role === 'admin'` fallback so superadmin-only nav items are not shown to regular admins.
Fix frontend ProtectedRoute: ensure roles=['superadmin'] strictly checks equality (no implicit admin bypass), so admin navigating to /admin/branding gets redirected/401.
Optional: return 400 explicitly on empty-file upload (currently 422 due to multipart validation).
critical_code_review_comments: The implicit-admin bypass in core.require_roles() is now actively leaking superadmin-only features (branding). It was documented as a minor concern in iter10 but the introduction of superadmin-only endpoints makes it a real security defect. Refactor require_roles to be strict and add a separate dependency (e.g. require_superadmin) or fix the current one.

Layout.jsx item filter duplicates authorization logic that is already in backend / ProtectedRoute and silently shows hidden areas due to the `|| user.role === 'admin'` fallback — this is a pure bug, not desired convenience.
branding.py _public_view correctly strips *_path and _id keys and adds *_url — good. No ObjectId leakage detected.
Pydantic regex for hex colors enforced, 422 returned for invalid values — validated.
Image pipeline (Pillow resize + WEBP/PNG conversion) works as spec: JPG 3840x2400 → WEBP 1920x1200 ~1.6KB, PNG 2048 → WEBP 512, PNG 256 → PNG 96 confirmed via tests.

success_rate.backend: 85% (22/26) — remaining 4 failures are the single RBAC leak bug
success_rate.frontend: 90% — all UI flows work; two RBAC leaks (sidebar + route) are the only issues

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes require_roles + Layout sidebar filter + ProtectedRoute strict mode, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_branding.py (all 26 should pass). Then Playwright-verify: (a) admin login -> sidebar has NO 'Branding' and NO 'Pannello SaaS' items, (b) admin navigating directly to /admin/branding gets redirected to /dashboard or shows unauthorized, (c) super login -> both items visible and page accessible.
rca_of_the_issue: Single root cause for the 3 RBAC findings: an implicit 'admin is always allowed' fallback exists in THREE independent layers — (1) backend core.require_roles(), (2) frontend Layout.jsx sidebar filter, (3) likely frontend ProtectedRoute. All three must be tightened. Reproduction: login admin@cleantec.it / admin123 → GET https://.../api/admin/branding with Bearer token returns 200 + full config. Or browse to /admin/branding directly and the page renders.
